title: AI Chatbot Generator
shortDescription: A SaaS-based AI chatbot generator that creates customizable chatbots and provides embeddable script tags for seamless website integration.
whatItSolves: Eliminates the need for businesses to build chatbots from scratch by allowing them to generate and deploy AI-powered chatbots instantly using their own knowledge base.
fullDescription:
Developed a full-stack AI chatbot generator platform where users can create custom chatbots by providing business details or knowledge base content.

The system processes this data and generates a unique embeddable JavaScript script tag that users can integrate into any website. Once embedded, the chatbot can interact with visitors in real-time, providing automated responses based on trained knowledge.

The platform follows a SaaS architecture with scalable Node.js microservices, JWT authentication, and a modern reactive UI.

skillsUsed.Backend: Node.js, Express.js, REST API, Embed Scripts

title: AI Notes Generator
shortDescription: An AI-powered notes generator platform with a credit-based usage system, enabling users to generate structured notes instantly.
whatItSolves: Helps students and professionals quickly generate high-quality notes without spending hours researching and writing, while controlling API usage through a credit-based system.
fullDescription:
Built a full-stack AI notes generation platform inspired by ChatGPT, where users can input topics or prompts and receive well-structured, AI-generated notes in real-time.

Implemented a credit-based system to manage and limit usage, simulating real-world SaaS monetization models. The platform includes secure authentication, dynamic prompt handling, markdown rendering, and export to PDF features.

title: CodeCraft AI IDE & Code Assistant
shortDescription: A web-based intelligent code editor with real-time AI code completion, bug fixing, and automated code review.
whatItSolves: Accelerates developer workflow by providing instant context-aware code suggestions, syntax debugging, and security audit reports inside a browser-based Monaco editor.
fullDescription:
CodeCraft is an online code studio integrating Monaco Editor with LLMs for real-time code completion, refactoring, and automated test generation.

Supports multiple languages including JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, and Go, featuring live execution sandboxes and syntax highlighting with sleek glassmorphic controls.
